Hat.Lure.description: In the Shire it's said a party is finished when someone, deep into many ales, comes back from the pantry wearing meat on their head. While funny, it can attract unwanted creatures.

Hat.Mason.name: Mason's Hat
Hat.Mason.description: A dust-covered cap worn by Blue Mountain stoneworkers. Bestows mastery over stonecutting and precise chiselling.

Hat.Metalworker.name: Metalworker's Slouch
Hat.Metalworker.description: A practical cap worn by the smiths rebuilding Arnor. Grants skill in basic metalworking.

Hat.Miner.name: Advanced Miner's Helm
Hat.Miner.description: A sturdy helm devised by the Red Mountain Dwarves after discovering the True-Quartz of Moria. Provides expertise in ore extraction and tunnel safety.

Hat.Researcher.name: Scholar's Cap
Hat.Researcher.description: An elegant cap worn by the learned of Rivendell, at least that is what the Trader said. Joke or not, it imbues the wearer with ancient knowledge and research methods.

Hat.Restorer.name: Mason's Hat Recipe
Hat.Restorer.description: Recipe to craft a dust-covered cap worn by Blue Mountain stoneworkers. Bestows mastery over stonecutting and precise chiselling.

Hat.Tinker.name: Tinker's Topper
Hat.Tinker.description: A well-worn cap favored by traveling Tinkers. Bestows the ability to see how something was crafted and unmake it.

Helmet.InvisibleItem.name: Helmet-less
Helmet.InvisibleItem.description: Apply this option to hide any equipped Helmet without affecting the Armor Rating.

Hide.name: Hide
Hide.description: Larger sections of animal skin, treated for use.

HideScraps.name: Hide Scraps
HideScraps.description: Small strips of hide hastily collected from hunted animals or scavenged from ancient leather works.

HolidayPack.MealTable.name: Celebration Table
HolidayPack.MealTable.description: Break out the fancy tableware and decorate for Yule-tide or any other celebration. A cosmetic alternative to the Meal Table, part of the Yule-tide Pack.

HolidayPack.MediumHearth.name: Yule-tide Hearth
HolidayPack.MediumHearth.description: Decorated mantle upon a roaring fire, perfect for the darkest nights of the year. A cosmetic alternative to the Tiled Hearth, part of the Yule-tide Pack.

HolidayPack.PresentPile.name: Present Pile
HolidayPack.PresentPile.description: What better treasure than presents? A Yule-tide cosmetic alternative to the Treasure Trove, part of the Yule-tide Pack.

HollyDecoration.A.name: Holly Wreath
HollyDecoration.A.description: A circular arrangement of Holly cuttings with crystal lights.

HollyDecoration.B.name: Holly Garland
HollyDecoration.B.description: A horizontal arrangement of Holly cuttings with crystal lights.

HollyDecoration.C.name: Holly Garland II
HollyDecoration.C.description: A longer horizontal arrangement of Holly cuttings with crystal lights.

HollyTreeCutting.name: Holly Cutting
HollyTreeCutting.description: Extracted from Holly Trees, this cutting is used in Yule-tide decorations. Can be planted to grow a Holly Tree.

Improvised.Broken.name: Broken Improvised Axe
Improvised.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Iron.name: Iron Ore
Iron.description: Common tool used to rebuild statues and restore damaged buildings.

Iron.Broken.name: Broken Iron Hammer
Iron.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

IronHills.Gloves.name: Iron Hills Gloves
IronHills.Gloves.description: Iron gloves of practical, protective metalcraft.

IronHills.Shield.name: Iron Hills Shield
IronHills.Shield.description: Crafted in the Iron Hill’s fashion. Every young dwarf is taught how to forge, wield and sled on one.

IronHills.Torso.name: Iron Hills Armor
IronHills.Torso.description: A basic breastplate for both mining and defense. An Iron Hill Dwarf’s favorite.

IronHills_APSet_GlovesArmor.name: Iron Hills Gloves
IronHills_APSet_GlovesArmor.description: A fragment of a forgotten knowledge

IronHills_APSet_Shield.name: Iron Hills Shield
IronHills_APSet_Shield.description: A fragment of a forgotten knowledge

IronHills_APSet_TorsoArmor.name: Iron Hills Armor
IronHills_APSet_TorsoArmor.description: A fragment of a forgotten knowledge

IronIngot.name: Iron Ingot
IronIngot.description: The origin metal of dwarves and metal-craft. The first ingredient in many recipes.

Ironwood.name: Ironwood
Ironwood.description: A strengthened wood harvested by Dwarven lumbersmiths long ago.

Ironwood.Broken.name: Broken Ironwood Pickaxe
Ironwood.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Item.AncientWood.name: Ubâsam Wood
Item.AncientWood.description: Strong fungal wood from the Deeps, previously thought a tall tale.

Item.BoltsOfCloth.name: Numenorean Cloth
Item.BoltsOfCloth.description: Cloth woven from the finest imported fabrics of an ancient time.

Item.Bone.name: Bones
Item.Bone.description: A dead material still of much use to the living.

Item.BronzeIngot.name: Bronze Ingot
Item.BronzeIngot.description: The favorite metal of Elven craftsman. Excels as a material for weapons, tools and even buildings.  Alloyed from Tin and Copper.

Item.Chitin.name: Chitin
Item.Chitin.description: Pieces of insect shell. Useful for various purposes when ground into powder.

Item.ClothScraps.name: Cloth Scraps
Item.ClothScraps.description: Ragged fabric stubs of unknown origin.

Item.Coin.name: Coin
Item.Coin.description: Once valuable currency, a treasure-hoarder’s delight.

Item.CopperIngot.name: Copper Ingot
Item.CopperIngot.description: A metal that makes a strong friend to softer metals. A favorite material for brewery buidling.

Item.DrakeBones.name: Drake Bones
Item.DrakeBones.description: Ritually extracted from the body of a Drake for use in building a decorative trophy.

Item.ElvenTreeCutting.name: Elven Tree Cutting
Item.ElvenTreeCutting.description: Cut branch that will grow into an Elven tree when planted.

Item.Feathers.name: Feathers
Item.Feathers.description: Cast-offs from the birds of the caves.

Item.FellBeastHead.name: Fell Beast Head
Item.FellBeastHead.description: Wall-mounted Trophy built by a fearsome Orc Hunter.

Item.Fertilizer.name: Soil Dressing
Item.Fertilizer.description: Rich compost and manure for growing better crops. Turns poor soil into fertile earth for abundant harvests.

Item.FireclayBrick.name: Fireclay Brick
Item.FireclayBrick.description: Special clay bricks forged with Red Mountain craft. Essential for kilns, forges, and any construction that faces great heat.

Item.GoldIngot.name: Gold Ingot
Item.GoldIngot.description: An efficient way to store Gold ore. But also used for crafting and coin minting.

Item.GunMetalIngot.name: Shanôr Ingot
Item.GunMetalIngot.description: A pliable metal perfected by the Belegost refugees. Alloyed from Silver, Tin and Copper.

Item.GundabadScrap.name: Gundabad Slag
Item.GundabadScrap.description: A once-splendid metal of Mt. Gundabad too corrupted by Orcs for use.

Item.Hide.name: Hide
Item.Hide.description: Larger sections of animal skin, treated for use.

Item.HideScraps.name: Hide Scraps
Item.HideScraps.description: Small strips of hide hastily collected from hunted animals or scavenged from ancient leather works.

Item.HollyTreeCutting.name: Holly Tree Cutting
Item.HollyTreeCutting.description: Extracted from Holly Trees, this cutting is used in Yule-tide decorations. Can be planted to grow a Holly Tree.

Item.IronIngot.name: Iron Ingot
Item.IronIngot.description: The origin metal of dwarves and metal-craft. The first ingredient in many recipes.

Item.Ironwood.name: Ironwood
Item.Ironwood.description: A strengthened wood harvested by Dwarven lumbersmiths long ago.

Item.IthildinIngot.name: Ithildin Ingot
Item.IthildinIngot.description: This metal, translated as Starmoon, was originally created by the Elves. When worked into craft it glows in moon and starlight. Alloyed from Mithril and True-quartz.

Item.KhazadSteelIngot.name: Khazâd Steel Ingot
Item.KhazadSteelIngot.description: A stouter variety of steel that alloys itself with Gold. Forged through techniques favored by the Dwarves of Khazad-dûm at its height.

Item.MithrilIngot.name: Mithril Ingot
Item.MithrilIngot.description: A bar of the strongest, most lustrous known metal. An efficient way to store Mithril ore.

Item.NaturalFiber.name: Natural Fiber
Item.NaturalFiber.description: Thread-like material such as Spider silk or Rope Vines that are used to construct Rope Ladders.

Item.NogrodSteelIngot.name: Nogrod Steel Ingot
Item.NogrodSteelIngot.description: This damasked alloy of Iron, True-quartz and Sun-stone was invented in the First Age by Dwarven smiths of Nogrod. It shines with the light of the sun and moon.

Item.OrcSkull.name: Rukhus Skull
Item.OrcSkull.description: Collected from a fallen Orc, Goblin or Uruk to use in building a decorative trophy.

Item.PurifiedDarkIngot.name: Durinul Iron Ingot
Item.PurifiedDarkIngot.description: The sacred metal of Durin the First. Made by purifying Gundabad Slag of its corruption.

Item.QualityWood.name: Elven Wood
Item.QualityWood.description: The fast-growing wood of Elvish forests.

Item.QuietMoss.name: Sunken Moss
Item.QuietMoss.description: This small plant can be used in a variety of alchemical brews.

Item.Scales.name: Scales
Item.Scales.description: A handful of scales from a reptilian and draconic creatures.

Item.Scrap.name: Metal Scraps
Item.Scrap.description: A once-splendid metal of Mt. Gundabad too corrupted by Orcs for use.

Item.SeaWax.name: Sea Wax
Item.SeaWax.description: Protective coating that shields metal from corrosion. Originally developed in coastal climates, the Dwarven army found it counteracts the corrosive humours of the Gundabad Orcs.

Item.Shell.name: Shell
Item.Shell.description: Polished shells gathered from western shores. Used to accent stonework and bring the beauty of the sea inland.

Item.Silk.name: Elven Silk
Item.Silk.description: A silken substance collected from spiders and their nests.

Item.SilverIngot.name: Silver Ingot
Item.SilverIngot.description: Makes gleaming jewelry, armor, and weapons and the highest quality. Its metal was favored by the First Age Dwarves.

Item.StarAlloyIngot.name: Star-metal Ingot
Item.StarAlloyIngot.description: A bar of Star-metal, dark and alluring as the night sky.

Item.SteelIngot.name: Steel Ingot
Item.SteelIngot.description: A stouter variety of steel that alloys itself with Gold. Forged through techniques favored by the Dwarves of Khazad-dûm at its height.

Item.WargPelt.name: Warg Pelt
Item.WargPelt.description: Fur and skin of the dangerous Orc companions. Can be mounted as a trophy or used as a rug.

Item.Wood.name: Wood Scraps
Item.Wood.description: Short wooden support for barriors or bannisters.

Item.Wool.name: Northern Wool
Item.Wool.description: Thick fleece from the hardy flocks that graze the northern lands of Arnor and the Shire. Prized for its warmth and softness, essential for clothing in the cooler climates of northern Middle-earth.

ItemRack.ShieldHook.name: Wall Display
ItemRack.ShieldHook.description: Hangs a shield, weapon or pack on the wall.

IthildinIngot.name: Ithildin Ingot
IthildinIngot.description: This metal, translated as Starmoon, was originally created by the Elves. When worked into craft it glows in moon and starlight. Alloyed from Mithril and True-quartz.

JunkPile.name: Tinker's Junk Pile
JunkPile.description: A more-or-less organized pile of items the Delving no longer needs. A Tinker will spend time breaking items into their raw materials. Any contents can be permanently destroyed by the player.

Khazad.Boots.name: Khazâd Army Boots
Khazad.Boots.description: Heavy Khazâd Steel boots, often put on the day of battle as their weight made long marches even harder.

Khazad.Broken.name: Broken Khazâd War Axe
Khazad.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Khazad.Gloves.name: Khazâd Army Gauntlets
Khazad.Gloves.description: Plate armor protection for a Dwarve’s hands. When originally forged they often were costumized to the wearer’s weapon of choice.

Khazad.Helmet.name: Khazâd Army Helmet
Khazad.Helmet.description: A line of marching Dwarves bearing these horned helms could strike fear in the hearts of their enemies.

Khazad.Torso.name: Khazâd Army Armor
Khazad.Torso.description: This impressive heavy plate and scalloped armor once worn by Khazad-dûm’s soldiers into the Third Age.

KhazadBlack.Boots.name: Khazâd Army Boots Masharuz
KhazadBlack.Boots.description: Heavy Khazâd Steel boots. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.

KhazadBlack.Gloves.name: Khazâd Army Gauntlets Masharuz
KhazadBlack.Gloves.description: Plate armor protection for a Dwarve’s hands. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.

KhazadBlack.Helmet.name: Khazâd Army Helmet Masharuz
KhazadBlack.Helmet.description: Horned helm of war. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.

KhazadBlack.Torso.name: Khazâd Army Armor Masharuz
KhazadBlack.Torso.description: This impressive heavy plate and scalloped armor. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.

KhazadGold.Boots.name: Khazâd Army Boots Amzul
KhazadGold.Boots.description: Heavy Khazâd Steel boots. <Inventory.Regular.White>Amzul</>-gilded armor was given as a great honor by clan fathers.

KhazadGold.Gloves.name: Khazâd Army Gauntlets Amzul
KhazadGold.Gloves.description: Plate armor protection for a Dwarve’s hands. <Inventory.Regular.White>Amzul</>-gilded armor was given as a great honor by clan fathers.

KhazadGold.Helmet.name: Khazâd Army Helmet Amzul
KhazadGold.Helmet.description: Horned helm of war. <Inventory.Regular.White>Amzul</>-gilded armor was given as a great honor by clan fathers.

KhazadGold.Torso.name: Khazâd Army Armor Amzul
KhazadGold.Torso.description: This impressive heavy plate and scalloped armor. <Inventory.Regular.White>Amzul</>-gilded armor was given as a great honor by clan fathers.

KhazadSteelIngot.name: Khazâd Steel Ingot
KhazadSteelIngot.description: A stouter variety of steel that alloys itself with Gold. Forged through techniques favored by the Dwarves of Khazad-dûm at its height.

KhazadWhite.Boots.name: Khazâd Army Boots Shayar
KhazadWhite.Boots.description: Heavy Khazâd Steel boots. <Inventory.Regular.White>Shayar</> paint was traditional for Dwarves on pilgrimages.

KhazadWhite.Gloves.name: Khazâd Army Gauntlets Shayar
KhazadWhite.Gloves.description: Plate armor protection for a Dwarve’s hands. <Inventory.Regular.White>Shayar</> paint was traditional for Dwarves on pilgrimages.

KhazadWhite.Helmet.name: Khazâd Army Helmet Shayar
KhazadWhite.Helmet.description: Horned helm of war. <Inventory.Regular.White>Shayar</> paint was traditional for Dwarves on pilgrimages.

KhazadWhite.Torso.name: Khazâd Army Armor Shayar
KhazadWhite.Torso.description: This impressive heavy plate and scalloped armor. <Inventory.Regular.White>Shayar</> paint was traditional for Dwarves on pilgrimages.

Khazadstone.name: Khazadstone
Khazadstone.description: The Khazadstone will bring Durin's re-awakening.

Knife.Broken.name: *Broken Knife
Knife.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

KnowledgeBook.name: Build-lore Tome
KnowledgeBook.description: Ancient tome containing build-lore. Collect enough onto a Build-lore Case to gain a bonus to building.

KnowledgeScroll.name: Build-lore Scroll
KnowledgeScroll.description: Ancient vellum scroll containing build-lore. Collect enough onto Build-lore Shelves to gain a bonus to building.

Krampus.Boots.name: Kabrûn Boots
Krampus.Boots.description: Heavy iron-shod boots caked with stone dust and cave mud for the Deep-night celebration. Worn by Dwarves playing Kabrûn during the winter solstice festivities.

Krampus.Gloves.name: Kabrûn Gloves
Krampus.Gloves.description: Soot-stained gauntlets for <Inventory.Regular.White>Khufur-nagim-ul</> celebrations. Traditional costume pieces for those playing the Bell-dragger during the winter festival.

Krampus.Helmet.name: Kabrûn Mask
Krampus.Helmet.description: A horned helm with a grimacing face-plate, worn during <Inventory.Regular.White>Khufur-nagim-ul</> festivities. Coal-blackened and menacing, perfect for startling young Dwarves who may have been less than diligent at their workbenches this year.

Krampus.Torso.name: Kabrûn Costume
Krampus.Torso.description: Festive Deep-night outfit of tattered leather wrapped in chains and hung with small iron bells. Traditional costume for those portraying the Bell-dragger during the <Inventory.Regular.White>Khufur-nagim-ul</> celebration.

LonelyMountain.Torso.name: Lonely Mountain Outfit
LonelyMountain.Torso.description: A merchant outfit worn by Durin’s Folk of Erebor.

Lord.Flag.name: Lord of Moria Flag
Lord.Flag.description: A decorative cloth flag with the Lord of Moria's Company mark.

LordOfMoria.Boots.name: Lord's Boots
LordOfMoria.Boots.description: Ceremonial boots gifted to the newly named Lord of Moria by the King Under the Mountain.

LordOfMoria.Gloves.name: Lord's Gloves
LordOfMoria.Gloves.description: Ceremonial gloves gifted to the newly named Lord of Moria by the King Under the Mountain.

LordOfMoria.Helmet.name: Lord's Coronet
LordOfMoria.Helmet.description: Small, ceremonial crown gifted to the newly named Lord of Moria by the King Under the Mountain.

LordOfMoria.Torso.name: Lord's Armor
LordOfMoria.Torso.description: Ceremonial armor gifted to the newly named Lord of Moria by the King Under the Mountain.

Loupe.Broken.name: Broken Artisan's Adze
Loupe.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Marble.name: Coastal Marble
Marble.description: A basic floor made out of rough Fair blocks. The pale stone gleams softly like coastal moonlight.

MashPaddle.Broken.name: Broken Brewmaster's Paddle
MashPaddle.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Masterwork.Broken.name: *Broken Masterwork Hammer
Masterwork.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Mattock.Bronze.name: Last Alliance Maul
Mattock.Bronze.description: Forged from steel and bronze, these converted building-hammers filled out the armory of Durin IV. Great against armored enemies. Charge for a staggering uppercut.

Mattock.Khazad.name: Khazâd Maul
Mattock.Khazad.description: A great bludgeon stashed away for the last defense of a Dwarf’s home. Great against armored enemies. Charge for a staggering uppercut.

Mattock.Mithril.name: Muasgadnûr
Mattock.Mithril.description: The Armor Crusher, a legendary maul crafted from Mithril.

Mattock_1h_t2.name: Khazâd Maul
Mattock_1h_t2.description: A fragment of a forgotten knowledge.

MeatHat.name: Meat Hat
MeatHat.description: Crafting recipe for a hat made of meat. Used in the Shire at parties. While funny it can attract unwanted creatures.

Memorial.name: Memorial Flame
Memorial.description: A tribute to remember the fallen Dwarves who came before.

MereakPack_ShortMemorialStatue_A.name: Short Memorial Statue
MereakPack_ShortMemorialStatue_A.description: A Memorial Statue to honor the fallen

MiningMarker.name: Vein Marker
MiningMarker.description: A traditional Dwarven claim marker. Set near rich rock seams to designate where the Company should work. Miners will only work on veins near this.

MintSeed.name: Mint Seed
MintSeed.description: Seeds that grow into Mint when planted.

Mirror.name: Beam-mirror
Mirror.description: Also known as a Thrak-Kheled, it is used to redirect Moria's light shafts into a targeted beam.

Mithril.name: Mithril Ore
Mithril.description: The Fear Cleaver, a legendary war axe crafted from Mithril.

Mithril.Boots.name: Mithril Slippers
Mithril.Boots.description: Hard enough for battle yet comfortable enough to pair with a nightgown.

Mithril.Broken.name: Shards of Khushnabrak
Mithril.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Mithril.Gloves.name: Mithril Gloves
Mithril.Gloves.description: Using a distinct form of long-ringed mail, these full-arm gloves can turn blades away better than most shields.

Mithril.Helmet.name: Mithril Helmet
Mithril.Helmet.description: Magnificent in design and strength, this helmet has no equal among the craft of Elves, Men or Dwarves.

Mithril.Shield.name: Mithril Shield
Mithril.Shield.description: It is a rare gift to forge a shield with Mithril. Tradition held they were for ceremonial uses, despite being near-impenetrable.

Mithril.Torso.name: Mithril Armor
Mithril.Torso.description: A coat of scalloped Mithril and fine cloth. Worth the whole of a small realm. Supple and strong, nothing will skewer this armor.

MithrilIngot.name: Mithril Ingot
MithrilIngot.description: A bar of the strongest, most lustrous known metal. An efficient way to store Mithril ore.

MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_A.name: Mithril Overlayed Wall
MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_A.description: A granite wall with mithril plating

MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_B.name: Mithril Overlayed Wall II
MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_B.description: A granite wall with mithril plating and decorative patterns.

MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_C.name: Mithril Overlayed Relief
MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_C.description: Granite wall with a mithril relief of a Dwarf wearing a helmet.

MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_D.name: Mithril Overlayed Relief II
MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_D.description: Granite wall with a silver relief of a Dwarf with braided hair.

MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_E.name: Mithril Overlayed Relief III
MithrilWallsPack_MithrilWall_E.description: Granite wall with a silver relief of a Dwarf with braided hair flanked by two Dwarves wearing helmets

Monument.1st.name: Zagal of Wealth
Monument.1st.description: A massive geode split open to reveal crystalline beauty within, displaying the vast natural wealth of Moria. Building this will spread word of the abundance to be had here and will unlock the Trading Camp outside the Westgate.

Monument.2nd.name: Flame of Dashûn
Monument.2nd.description: A metal spire of Dashun, or pride, houses an eternal vertical flame that burns without fuel or tending.

Monument.3rd.name: Pillar of Unukh-âhîn
Monument.3rd.description: A towering cylinder carved with the likenesses of the Unukh-âhîn, the Seven Fathers of the Dwarven clans. Modelled after a long ruined second-age monument in Dwarrowdelf, completing this sends word that the Company is here to stay.

Monument.4th.name: Archive of Umrad-ukhfur
Monument.4th.description: A hollow pillar containing Umrad-ukhfur, scrolls and books of forgotten lore.

Monument.5th.name: Vault of Khafrûn-unshi
Monument.5th.description: An impregnable vault built to contain that which must never see light. This khafrûn-unshi, or sealed evil, is dangerous to wield, yet too precious to destroy.

Monument.Beacon.name: Beacon of Tahbûn
Monument.Beacon.description: This crystal beacon crowns Zirak-zigil, its light visible across all Middle-earth. As its name, Tahbûn, infers it is a rallying call to all scattered Dwarves that Moria welcomes them home. Restoring the Beacon unlocks the Recruiting Camp outside the Dimrill Gate.

Monument.OathCircle.name: Circle of Zabad-Durinul
Monument.OathCircle.description: A ring of stone circles surrounding a central pedestal. Its use is unknown but resembles crude oath circles used in Dwarven family inheritance and marriage rituals. There is no greater place to cement an oath than on this peak.

MoonStone.name: True-quartz
MoonStone.description: Also called <Inventory.Regular.White>Uzug-Zarôk</>, or Moon-stone. This crystalline ore glows like the Moon when exposed to any light.

MoriaCompany.Shield.name: Company of Moria Shield
MoriaCompany.Shield.description: Bearing the marks of the Lord of Moria, this shield is given to the brave Dwarves who volunteer to join the effort to prepare for Durin's return.

NPC.Basket.name: Salvager's Creel
NPC.Basket.description: Sturdy woven container for gathering materials from the ruins of Moria. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Salvager.

NPC.BlacksmithHammer.name: Blacksmith's Mallet
NPC.BlacksmithHammer.description: Heavy hammer designed for shaping hot iron on the anvil. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Blacksmith.

NPC.Chisel.name: Builder's Mallet
NPC.Chisel.description: Specialized tool with a chisel's edge used for hammering, chipping and shaping stone. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Builder.

NPC.FryingPan.name: Cook's Frying Pan
NPC.FryingPan.description: Heavy iron pan for cooking meals over hearth and fire. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Cook.

NPC.GrocerStaff.name: Grocer's Staff
NPC.GrocerStaff.description: Sturdy walking stick with hooks and pouches for gathering wild or farmed provisions. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Grocer.

NPC.Loupe.name: Artisan's Adze
NPC.Loupe.description: A curved axe head used for smoothing wood and crafting high quality goods. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Artisan.

NPC.Scissors.name: Tailor's Shears
NPC.Scissors.description: Sharp cutting blades for precise work with cloth and thread. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Tailor.

NPC.Spanner.name: Tinker's Spanner
NPC.Spanner.description: Precision tool for taking apart crafted goods to reclaim their materials. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Tinker.

NPC.Tong.name: Metalworker's Stoking Rod
NPC.Tong.description: Heavy iron poker designed for handling hot metal and molten ore. Equipping this to any Company Dwarf with the right skill will assign them the role of Metalworker.

NaturalFiber.name: Natural Fiber
NaturalFiber.description: Thread-like material such as Spider silk or Rope Vines that are used to construct Rope Ladders.

Nogrod.Broken.name: Broken Red Axe of Nogrod
Nogrod.Broken.description: Use the Repair Smithy to mend.

Nogrod.Gloves.name: Nogrod Gauntlets
Nogrod.Gloves.description: Plate metal gauntlets that increase attack strength but causes more vulnerability.

Nogrod.Shield.name: Nogrod Shield
Nogrod.Shield.description: The Nogrod smiths are known for their weapon making, despite the beauty of their shield designs.

Nogrod.Torso.name: Nogrod Armor
Nogrod.Torso.description: Known for their weapon making not their armor, this damasked plate increases the power of a Dwarf’s attack, yet leaves them vulnerable to the attacks of others.

NogrodBlack.Gloves.name: Nogrod Gauntlets Masharuz
NogrodBlack.Gloves.description: Plate metal gauntlets that increase attack strength but causes more vulnerability. <Inventory.Regular.White>Masharuz</>-fashion was worn by grieving Dwarves on missions of vengeance.

Torso.Blacksmith.description: Recipe to craft this cosmetic, heavy leather outfit designed to protect against forge sparks and heat. Essential wear for any dwarf working hot iron.

Torso.Cook.description: Recipe to craft this cosmetic, practical outfit for hearth and kitchen work. Designed to keep flour dust and cooking stains at bay.

Torso.Restorer.name: Stonemason's Garb Recipe
Torso.Restorer.description: Recipe to craft this cosmetic, sturdy outfit built to withstand dust and stone chips.

Torso.Shopkeeper.name: Keeper's Vest Recipe
Torso.Shopkeeper.description: Recipe to craft this cosmetic, respectable outfit for those who tend shops and storehouses. Clean, practical garments that inspire customer confidence.

Torso.Trader.name: Merchant's Attire Recipe
Torso.Trader.description: Recipe to craft this cosmetic, well-made traveling outfit suitable for the road and marketplace. Garments that command respect in any trading hall.

TrackingDevice.name: Raven's Glimmer
TrackingDevice.description: A tiny, polished silver disc. Ravens are trained to see the flashes of light that glimmer off it, helping them track just about anything.

TradeGoods.ArmyAle.name: Campaign Ale Barrels
TradeGoods.ArmyAle.description: Bulk barrels of strong brew designed to supply entire armies on campaign. Fortifies morale as much as the body.

TradeGoods.ArnorBrew.name: Northern Ale Barrels
TradeGoods.ArnorBrew.description: Barrels of strong brew crafted specifically for the hardy men rebuilding Arnor. A bulk export that warms spirits and strengthens resolve through cold northern nights.

TradeGoods.BrassButtons.name: Brass Buttons
TradeGoods.BrassButtons.description: Polished brass buttons crafted to Hobbit preferences and sizing. No respectable vest is complete without proper Dwarven fasteners.

TradeGoods.BronzeCoins.name: Bronze Coins
TradeGoods.BronzeCoins.description: Standard bronze currency minted for foreign trade partners. Reliable coinage that holds its value across many lands.

TradeGoods.BronzeShipFittings.name: Naval Bronzework
TradeGoods.BronzeShipFittings.description: Precisely crafted bronze hardware for ships and boats. From cleats to hinges, each piece withstands the salt spray and endless sea.

TradeGoods.BuildingHouseingTools.name: Dwarven Builder's Kit
TradeGoods.BuildingHouseingTools.description: Precisely forged tools that make light work of stone and timber. No construction project is complete without Dwarven craftsmanship.

TradeGoods.CarvedMuralSections.name: Khazad Stone Reliefs
TradeGoods.CarvedMuralSections.description: Masterfully carved stone panels depicting the ancient glory of Khazad-dûm. Sought after by distant kingdoms to grace their halls with dwarven artistry.

TradeGoods.CeremonialArmorLot.name: Ceremonial Armor Set
TradeGoods.CeremonialArmorLot.description: Ornate armor crafted for ceremony rather than battle. Polished to mirror brightness, perfect for royal guards and formal occasions.

TradeGoods.CeremonialWeapons.name: Ceremonial Weapons
TradeGoods.CeremonialWeapons.description: Ornate weapons crafted for ceremony and display rather than battle. Polished steel that gleams in processions and formal occasions.

TradeGoods.CopperBeltBuckles.name: Copper Belt Buckles
TradeGoods.CopperBeltBuckles.description: Ornate belt fasteners wrought from finest copper. Functional metalwork that serves as both utility and decoration.

TradeGoods.CopperCoins.name: Copper Coins
TradeGoods.CopperCoins.description: Standard copper currency minted for distant lands. Reliable everyday coinage for markets and common transactions.

TradeGoods.CrossbowLot.name: Crossbow Arsenal
TradeGoods.CrossbowLot.description: A bulk shipment of precision crossbows forged for distant armies. Each weapon bears the hallmark of Dwarven engineering and deadly accuracy.

TradeGoods.CrystalLamps.name: Crystal Lamps
TradeGoods.CrystalLamps.description: Crystalline lamps that glow with their own inner fire, requiring no oil or wick. A marvel of ancient Dwarven knowledge restored.

TradeGoods.DecorativeMithrilWork.name: Mithril Ornaments
TradeGoods.DecorativeMithrilWork.description: Delicate true-silver worked into decorative pieces for halls and homes. Even the smallest accent gleams with otherworldly light.

TradeGoods.DiamondJewerly.name: Diamond Jewelry
TradeGoods.DiamondJewerly.description: Precious gems set in finest metal for the high and royal. Each piece proclaims the wealth and status of its wearer.

TradeGoods.DwarvenArrowheads.name: Steel Arrowheads
TradeGoods.DwarvenArrowheads.description: Razor-sharp points forged in bulk for fletchers across Middle-earth. No arrow flies truer than one tipped with Dwarven steel

TradeGoods.DwarvenHistories.name: Dwarven Histories
TradeGoods.DwarvenHistories.description: Beautifully illustrated manuscripts recounting the lost glory of the First and Second Ages. Knowledge preserved in gold leaf and careful script.

TradeGoods.EliteArmor.name: Prestige Armor
TradeGoods.EliteArmor.description: Masterwork set of armor using the finest alloys and craftsmanship. While too expensive to outfit an entire army, these are often ordered for leaders and royal guards.

TradeGoods.EliteWeapons.name: Prestige Weapons
TradeGoods.EliteWeapons.description: Masterwork set of weapons using the finest alloys and craftsmanship. While too expensive to outfit an entire army, these are often ordered for leaders and royal guards.

TradeGoods.EngravedAkhfurChests.name: Engraved Akhfur Chests
TradeGoods.EngravedAkhfurChests.description: A personal strongbox that opens only for its rightful owner. Engraved with protective runes that guard its contents from thieves.

TradeGoods.GemSetFiligreeInlay.name: Gem-set Filigree
TradeGoods.GemSetFiligreeInlay.description: Precious stones set within intricate gold threadwork for master crafters. Transforms ordinary goods into treasures worthy of kings and lords.

TradeGoods.GoldJewerly.name: Gold Jewelry
TradeGoods.GoldJewerly.description: Fine jewelry wrought from pure gold for those that love and covet such things. Each piece displays the skill that makes Dwarven goldwork legendary.

TradeGoods.GoldSilverFiligree.name: Gold & Silver Filigree
TradeGoods.GoldSilverFiligree.description: Delicate threads of gold and silver woven into intricate patterns. Used by master craftsmen to transform simple goods into works of precious metal art.

TradeGoods.HealingSupplies.name: Healer's Kit
TradeGoods.HealingSupplies.description: Essential supplies and instruments for tending battle wounds. Crafted tools that help healers mend what war has broken.

TradeGoods.HorsemansIronwork.name: Horse Ironwork
TradeGoods.HorsemansIronwork.description: Complete ironwork for horses and their riders including shoes, bits, and bridles. Everything needed to properly outfit horse and rider for farm work or travel.

TradeGoods.IronPotsAndPans.name: Kitchen Ironware
TradeGoods.IronPotsAndPans.description: Sturdy cooking vessels forged for daily use in hearth and kitchen. Built to last generations of family meals.

TradeGoods.MechanicalToys.name: Dwarven Toys
TradeGoods.MechanicalToys.description: Ingenious mechanical contraptions that move and dance with intricate gears. These wondrous toys delight children and amaze all others in equal measure.

TradeGoods.MirroredGlass.name: Engraved Mirrors
TradeGoods.MirroredGlass.description: Mastercrafted mirrors made from Mirrored Silver. Used for decoration or agricultural uses.

TradeGoods.MithrilJewerly.name: Mithril Jewelry
TradeGoods.MithrilJewerly.description: True-silver worked into jewelry of unmatched beauty and lightness. More precious than gold, worn only by those with the ability to acquire such treasure.

TradeGoods.OrnateMetalwork.name: Decorative Metalwork
TradeGoods.OrnateMetalwork.description: Elaborate metalwork wrought with Dwarven skill and artistry. Transforms any dwelling from humble shelter to noble residence.

TradeGoods.OrnateTablewear.name: Ornate Tablewear
TradeGoods.OrnateTablewear.description: Elaborate serving pieces and dining implements for grand feasts. Crafted to grace the tables of the most discerning hosts.

TradeGoods.PrecisionMeasurementTools.name: Surveyor's Instruments
TradeGoods.PrecisionMeasurementTools.description: Intricate devices for measuring land, angles, and distances. Essential for any grand construction or mapping endeavor.

TradeGoods.RohanAle.name: Riddermark Brew Barrels
TradeGoods.RohanAle.description: Barrels of brew crafted to the tastes of the horse-lords. Strong ale for strong riders of the mark.

TradeGoods.RunicHearthstones.name: Runic Hearthstones
TradeGoods.RunicHearthstones.description: Ancient Dwarven runes carved into stone bricks that radiate warmth without flame. A blessing for any hearth during the long winter months.

TradeGoods.ShireAle.name: Underhill Brew Barrels
TradeGoods.ShireAle.description: Gentle ales brewed to hobbit preferences for their inns and taverns. Light enough for second breakfast, hearty enough for elevenses.

TradeGoods.SilverCoins.name: Silver Coins
TradeGoods.SilverCoins.description: Freshly minted silver coins ready to be used as currency. Bearing the symbols and marks desired by the distant lands that ordered them.

TradeGoods.StarmetalCoins.name: Starmetal Coins
TradeGoods.StarmetalCoins.description: Rare coins minted from meteoric metal for distant realms. Their otherworldly gleam makes counterfeiting nearly impossible.

TradeGoods.SteelWeaponsLot.name: Weapons Cache
TradeGoods.SteelWeaponsLot.description: A comprehensive armory of steel blades and points ready for export. Forged to Dwarven standards, trusted by warriors across Middle-earth.

TradeGoods.TinCoins.name: Tin Coins
TradeGoods.TinCoins.description: Light tin currency minted for distant realms. Practical coinage for small purchases and everyday commerce.

TradeGoods.TravelingGear.name: Traveler's Gear
TradeGoods.TravelingGear.description: Sturdy leather packs and traveling equipment built to last long journeys. Essential gear for merchants and adventurers alike.

TradeGoods.TrebuchetParts.name: Siege Components
TradeGoods.TrebuchetParts.description: Heavy iron fittings and mechanisms for building siege weapons. The backbone of any army's wall-breaking capability.

TradeGoods.WoodWorkingTools.name: Carpenter's Kit
TradeGoods.WoodWorkingTools.description: Precision tools for shaping timber and joining wood. No Carpenter's workshop is complete without dwarven-forged implements.
